name: Lights-Out: Ceiling Ticks
read_aloud: LIGHTS OUT. Red emergency lighting only. Remain in place until the cycle ends.
narrator_line: LIGHTS OUT. Red emergency lighting only.
layout: Whatever room the party is in when the Pit goes dark for the hour; red emergency light only, everything reads as dim.

features.name: Whatever the room provides; furniture and doorways.
Red dim light for the hour.
Ceiling Ticks drop from vents and light fixtures.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: The Pit goes dark for an hour and Ceiling Ticks drop from the vents.
quick_run.decision: Fight in the red light, or retreat to somewhere with a door?
quick_run.on_success: The Ticks are cleared and the dark hour passes.
quick_run.on_failure: Bitten and shaken, the party loses time and a short-rest slot.
quick_run.cut_short: Resolve it as a single exchange: one roll for the party, one cost.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
